name: 3d-card
blurb: Card elements rotate and tilt in 3D space following cursor movement.
description: Composite 3D card system: CardContainer tracks mouse position and applies rotateY/X transforms; CardBody is the card wrapper; CardItem elements translate and rotate in 3D on hover. Uses CSS perspective and preserve-3d.
use_when: Hero cards, feature showcases, or product demonstrations where visual depth and interactivity impress.
avoid_when: Mobile-only or accessibility-focused sites — 3D transforms don't work well on touch, and motion may disorient.
a11y: No keyboard navigation for the 3D effect. Content inside is accessible, but visual depth is mouse-only.
